_comment: Pre-existing shared-row writes on a hand's path that cannot be removed in incident 075013fd. Read by scripts/ci/check-hand-path-shared-writes.mjs; every entry names function, kind, target, owner, reason, date (tests/a-hands-money-path-never-writes-a-shared-row.law.test.ts). This list is DEBT: remove an entry in the change that removes the write. The 14 that #11270/#11266 remove (atomic_distribute_rake, bbj_record_contribution, fn_bbj_allocate, record_insurance_transaction, the envelope's bbj-pool lock and pool row, and through them trg_union_rake_weekly and fn_bbj_contribution_drops_cached_hours) are deliberately NOT here.
measured: 2026-11-18 read-only on production kuklfnapbkmacvwxktbh: 875 functions on the path, 37 violations before #11270/#11266, 23 expected after.

entries.reason: Reached only through trg_allocate_lifetime_vip_diamond_spend, which fires WHEN (new.amount < 0) on diamond_transactions; the hand path gets there from poker_diamond_jackpot_accept_hand -> fn_poker_diamond_jackpot_pay -> add_diamonds_to_balance, which CREDITS diamonds, so a hand does not take this branch. The reader cannot evaluate trigger WHEN clauses. Remove when fn_ca_burn takes the union/club rows NOWAIT or the jackpot pay stops sharing add_diamonds_to_balance with spends.

Reached from the settlement door through fn_sync_tournament_current_players (tournament_players status changes on a bust) into the BEFORE UPDATE OF status triggers on tournaments; it locks the club/union wallet only on a tournament status transition (overlay funding at lock, start readiness), not per hand. Still a tournament event inside a hand's commit (owner ruling 2026-11-17: a tournament issue must never affect other games): move it to the tournament's own lane.
